title: Check Engine Light Diagnosis
subtitle: Calm triage: solid vs flash → scan → plain English → safe DIY or shop.
tone: Calm diagnostic coach. Never scare, never dismiss. Flashing = immediate. Never primary-CTA 'just clear codes'. Max 2 buttons. Trust every ~3 steps. Final: legal disclaimer on operational steps; high-risk modal + checkbox before continue.

ux_rules.trust_reminder_default: If you're unsure at any point, stop and go to a shop — that's the smart call, not quitting.
ux_rules.safety_disclaimer_default: 此为通用指导，最终请参考您的车辆手册或咨询授权技师。本App不对DIY操作导致的损坏负责。

prerequisites: OBD-II scanner or Bluetooth adapter (1996+ US)
Flashing + rough = reduce load / stop safe ASAP
tools_checklist: Optional: gas cap, MAF cleaner, gloves
parts_checklist: Depends on code — don't buy until codes + symptoms agree

adaptive_rules.coach_note: Flashing CEL while driving usually means active misfire — catalytic converter risk.
Many solid CELs after fueling are EVAP / loose gas cap — confirm with the code.
Hybrids may need more than a $20 generic reader for HV modules.
Diesel CELs often involve DPF/DEF/EGR — don't just clear into limp mode.
Generic OBD may miss module codes — full scan if symptoms persist.
High-mile misfires often want plugs/coils/vacuum checks — verify the code first.

visual_assets.shot_description: Calm amber CEL pulse — not apocalyptic.
Find port → plug in → code on phone.
Two panels animate: solid vs flashing.
MAF cleaner only; red X on carb cleaner.
Code → meaning → DIY vs shop tags.

steps.title: We'll sort the light calmly
steps.coach_encourage: You're facing the light instead of ignoring it — that's the win.

steps.description: First split: solid light and drives OK, or flashing / running rough?
steps.safety_warning: Flashing + shaking: reduce speed, stop safe. Continuing can kill the catalytic converter.

steps.title: Flashing — protect the cat
steps.coach_encourage: Treating this as urgent is exactly right. Slow down.
steps.description: Ease off. Avoid hard hills. Scan today if safe, or tow. Do not clear and keep driving on a flash.
steps.safety_warning: Clearing a flashing light hides the warning without fixing the misfire.
steps.trust_nudge: If you're unsure, stop and go to a shop — that's the smart call, not quitting.

risk_confirm.title: Flashing CEL — catalyst risk
risk_confirm.body: Driving hard on a flashing Check Engine light can destroy the catalytic converter and may indicate active misfire. Reduce load; stop safe. Do not clear and keep driving.

steps.title: Read the code(s)
steps.coach_encourage: One code photo saves hours of guessing. Good.
steps.description: OBD port is usually left of the steering column under the dash. Key on. Record every code + freeze-frame.
steps.safety_warning: Park in park/neutral with brake on.
steps.personalize: Pull codes on your {{make}} before buying parts at {{mileage}} mi.

steps.title: Getting a code without stress
steps.coach_encourage: Parts-store scans are fine — keep going.
steps.description: Borrow/buy a Bluetooth adapter, visit an auto-parts counter scan, or book a shop. Photo the screen when you have it.

steps.title: Safe DIY vs shop
steps.coach_encourage: Shop diagnostics on mystery codes often saves money. Smart options either way.
steps.description: DIY-friendly: gas cap, air filter, careful MAF clean, plug/coil when a cylinder is named. Shop: catalyst, timing, wiring, diesel emissions, hybrid modules.
steps.safety_warning: Poor performance, climbing temp, or oil/coolant mix — stop DIY.

variants.description: Vague single generic code? Pay for a full-system scan before ordering sensors.

steps.personalize: At {{mileage}} mi, misfire/catalyst codes are more common — verify first.

steps.title: DIY: gas cap / EVAP
steps.coach_encourage: Often the cheapest fix — one careful check. Slowly.
steps.description: Inspect the seal, tighten until it clicks. Clear only after a real fix — then drive a few cycles. Not EVAP? Skip to other DIY.
steps.safety_warning: Don't clear codes just to pass inspection — you lose freeze-frame clues.
steps.personalize: EVAP path for your {{make}} — click-tight cap, then monitor.
steps.safety_disclaimer: 此为通用指导，最终请参考您的车辆手册或咨询授权技师。本App不对DIY操作导致的损坏负责。

risk_confirm.title: EVAP / clear-code caution
risk_confirm.body: Clearing codes without a fix can hide freeze-frame data and fail inspections later. Fix first, then monitor drive cycles.

steps.title: Optional: careful MAF clean
steps.coach_encourage: This step is important — only if it fits. Skipping is OK.
steps.description: Engine off. Unplug. MAF cleaner only — never carb cleaner, never touch the wire. Air dry fully.
steps.safety_warning: Wrong cleaner destroys the sensor. Unsure it's MAF? Skip.
steps.trust_nudge: If you're unsure this is your issue, stop and go to a shop — that's the smart call, not quitting.
steps.personalize: Only if your {{model}} codes point to MAF/fuel trims.
steps.safety_disclaimer: 此为通用指导，最终请参考您的车辆手册或咨询授权技师。本App不对DIY操作导致的损坏负责。

risk_confirm.title: MAF sensor cleaning
risk_confirm.body: Wrong cleaner or touching the element can destroy the sensor. Only proceed if codes/symptoms fit. When unsure, skip and see a technician.
